segments.ja354:1.1: Uragova tacaṃ jiṇṇaṃ, hitvā gacchati saṃ tanuṃ;
segments.ja354:1.3: Evaṃ sarīre nibbhoge, pete kālaṅkate sati.
segments.ja354:2.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, gato so tassa yā gati.
segments.ja354:3.1: Anavhito tato āgā, ananuññāto [nānuññāto (ka.)] ito gato;
segments.ja354:3.3: Yathāgato tathā gato, tattha kā paridevanā.
segments.ja354:4.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, gato so tassa yā gati.
segments.ja354:5.1: Sace rode kisā [kisī (pī.)] assaṃ, tassā me kiṃ phalaṃ siyā;
segments.ja354:6.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, gato so tassa yā gati.
segments.ja354:8.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, gato so tassa yā gati.
segments.ja354:10.3: Tasmā etaṃ na socāmi, gato so tassa yā gatīti.
